text: Annditii an yo Nulaaɗo, tuma nde sukaaɓe gomɗinɓe ɓen moolinoo e diina mun kan ɓe fattoyii, ɓe wi'i e nder noddugol maɓɓe ngol Joomi maɓɓe: "Joomi amen, okku men Hinnayee immorde ka Maa ɗun woni haforanaa men bakkatuuji amen, danndaa men ayɓe e amen, waɗanaa men fiyaake fergu ngun iwde e keefeeru yaha e gomɗinal feewude faade e laawol Goonga e Peewal.
